text: there is a component we made that was inspiried from some designing in claude.ai/design but the actual outcome of the component took the design document and demo i think far too literal and then completely gapped the last step of it being the shader control, the thing is when you look at the documents from the design hopefully its clear that the 4 or 5 different views it has for it is a very solid grounding basis but the outcome of it while i will say the actual colors it surfaces are genuinely a lot better than the basic color wheel we had before, it just feels extremely complex because the demo never really unified the whole thing into one coherent substrate it just more lines out the different capabilties that are all very useful ideas but yeah i dont want to so much talk in circles but check out the @design_handoff_color_studio/ and then what was made of it that is in use in the @cart/editor/ ; and not the brushes to be mistaken, just purely 'paint'
